meta.title: Jeep ride 🚙 through Hai Van pass & Hoi An 🏮 tailored clothes 👗 Ep. 6: Solo Backpacking Vietnam 🇻🇳
meta.description:
Hello everyone! Welcome back to my channel and to episode 6 of my solo female backpacking Vietnam. In this episode we left Hue and got into open-air jeeps! We drove through the stunning landscapes of the Hai Van pass, which divides northern and southern Vietnam. The end of the road trip brought us to Hoi An. This is a popular city for tourists and it is easy to see why. Walking in the old quarter you can marvel at the old architecture and take in the numerous lanterns hanging from above. You're transported back in time to old Vietnam and it's this charm that makes Hoi An a top tourist destination. The other big draw is the custom-made tailored clothing. People travel from around the world to get clothes made by the thousands of tailors you can find here. It felt like there were more tailor shops in Hoi An than lanterns - which is saying something! I definitely indulged and had a couple clothes tailor-made for my measurements - which was pretty awesome. While I did have some unfortunate events happen in Hoi An, and the tour group dynamics were testing my patience - I was able to set all of that aside and celebrate my 31st birthday. The tour guide bought me a cake and it was a special, thoughtful moment during the group dinner. 

Thank you so much for watching and don't forget to subscribe to watch the next episode! We continued travelling down south along the coast. 

Kyra Mioso
XO
❤️🌺
